svg.aria-label: NarrateClaude + Ohm. Talk to your Mac, hear it reply in your own cloned voice. 100% private, works on a plane, and the Ohm web chat brings the same loop to any browser at zero API cost. Pocket TTS · Apple Silicon · Flask. RealTimeAICam. The biggest free open-vocabulary detector that fits on an iPhone: 601 classes, OCR, LiDAR depth, all on-device. The seed of the robot's vision stack. YOLOv8 · CoreML · Swift · LiDAR.
